::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Febry 5th [1864]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne, Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 19[^1]
:::

Dear [Mr Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd)

I am not certain whether it was mentioned that sheets of the [Trial](cmy_books/cmybook_53.qmd) were to be sent to [Messrs Williams and Norgate](organizations/other_165.qmd) to be forwarded to [M. Tauchnitz](people/person_1396.qmd). He has just written to me to ask for them which makes me mention it.

I send the chapters of The Trial, all but the three last, which shall follow in a week or fortnight.

Yours faithfully
C. M. Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
